test_title: PYST 5: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
solution:
The correct answer is '**responsible**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ 
• The passage emphasizes the qualities required for a healthy and progressive **democracy**. 
• In the context of the sentence, the blank (4) follows '**informed**', suggesting another positive attribute that describes the **citizenry** or the collective body of people. 
• '**Responsible**' fits perfectly as it refers to citizens who are **accountable**, follow civic rules, and participate in social causes. 
• An '**informed and responsible**' citizenry is a standard phrase used to describe the backbone of a successful **democratic** society. Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'. Complete Passage: *A responsible citizen is not defined merely by legal obligations but also by their contribution to the community. Civic sense includes following rules, respecting public spaces, and participating in social causes. When citizens (1) **overlook**__ basic responsibilities, society begins to suffer. Littering, ignoring traffic rules, or staying silent in the face of injustice are signs of weak civic values. It is important to understand that progress depends on (2) __**collective**__ efforts. Educated individuals must not remain passive observers but take the lead in creating awareness. Acts like voting, volunteering, and speaking against wrongdoing can lead to meaningful change. Social responsibility is not just a duty-it is a (3) __**privilege**__. strength of democracy lies in an informed and (4) __**responsible**__ When people unite with a shared vision, communities grow stronger. The real citizenry that upholds justice, equality, and the (5) __**common**__ good.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 
• **Passive**: This means accepting or allowing what happens or what others do, without active response or resistance; it is the opposite of the active participation needed in a democracy. 
• **Indifferent**: This means having no particular interest or concern; an indifferent citizenry would lead to the decay of social values. 
• **Careless**: This means not giving sufficient attention or thought to avoiding harm or errors; it describes the negative behavior mentioned earlier in the passage (like littering). </ul
